buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: 5 technical electives, departmental approval; upper-division/graduate engineering, natural science, or math. MAE 197 not allowed; MAE 198/199 restricted.

buckets.label: Humanities & Social Sciences / GE
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units. Verified. Engineering-major placeholder for general-education units. At UCSD, GE is defined by the student's residential college (Revelle, Muir, Marshall, ERC, Sixth, Seventh), not by the MAE department, so there is no fixed department course list. The MAE B.S. only stipulates a minimum of 24 units of humanities/social-science/GE coursework; the specific approved courses come from the college's own GE section. Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/MAE-ug.html.
